fields.label: App Key
fields.description: The registry key of the app this site calls, for example helpdesk or erpnext

fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Untick to stop all provisioning to this site and to stop sending people to its origin

fields.label: Origin
fields.description: The address in a browser, https://host with no path (for example https://hd.example.test). People may be redirected here and only here.

fields.label: Internal URL
fields.description: The address this site uses to call the other site directly (server to server), for example http://hd-backend:8000

fields.label: Site Name
fields.description: The site name of the other site, sent as X-Frappe-Site-Name on internal calls

fields.label: API Key
fields.description: Of the provisioning service user on the other site (role NXERP Provisioner only)
